epic.title: epic-567-door: the door is the interface
epic.intent_and_why: Reveal the spec through the spine, not the launch order (#535): dispatch should start with 'start the spine with this identifier.'

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door end to end.
#535's mechanism is measured before it is built; a genuine gap in scripts/run_crew.py is closed, or an evidenced honest null is reported.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Evidenced measurement (commands + output), no assertion-only claims
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Source citations with line numbers, live proof from this session's own dispatch, and existing test coverage
good_enough.appetite: One focused session, weighted toward measurement

hard_constraints: Confine any code change to scripts/run_crew.py
Do not edit skills/** (except skills/workbench/**), specs/**, or scripts/mcp_spine_server.py this wave
fixed_decisions: Session identity is derived from the spine's own work_id, never caller-supplied

current_wave.objective: Measure #535 against run_crew.py's spine-only dispatch, spine_open, and spine_bind; build only what the measurement shows missing
exit_criteria: Verdict (delivered or honest null) is stated with evidence

issues.title: reveal the spec through the spine, not the launch order
issues.desired_outcome: Dispatch starts with an identifier bound to a spine, not pasted prose, wherever the mechanism can deliver it.
issues.useful_now: Settles whether #535 needs new code or is already delivered by wave-1 mechanism (PR #623).
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: notes-1.md's command+output evidence: CLI-backend spine-only dispatch is shipped and this session is live proof of it.
local_unknowns: How much of #535 wave 1 already delivered
Whether an identifier-only dispatch survives the ExternalBackend path
Whether specs/*.spine.toml covering only implementer and reviewer is enough surface

completed_outcomes.outcome: Measured run_crew.py's CLI-backend spine-only dispatch (handoff-optional, identity derived from work_id): already shipped in PR #623 and demonstrated live by this Commander session's own dispatch.

wave_evidence.claim: run_crew.py's CLI-backend can dispatch a crew with only a bound spine, no --handoff document, deriving session identity from work_id
wave_evidence.expected: handoff-optional dispatch works and identity is never caller-supplied
wave_evidence.observed: CrewSpec.__post_init__ requires only one of --handoff/--spine; build_crew_argv's spine-only branch emits 'call spine_status, your spine is already bound'; _crew_door_env derives SPINE_SESSION via assignment_session_name(work_id, gate, role); this session was itself launched this way (spine_lease claim succeeded with no session-id argument)
wave_evidence.source: scripts/run_crew.py:813-820,1010-1048,1369-1383; python -m pytest tests/test_crew_launcher.py -k "spine_only or refuses_spine or spine_status" -q -> 14 passed

wave_evidence.claim: ExternalBackend (the Agent-tool-harness crew dispatch path) can also go spine-only
wave_evidence.expected: n/a -- this claim was tested and found false
wave_evidence.observed: ExternalBackend.dispatch raises CrewLaunchError whenever spec.handoff is None, even with spec.spine given; deliberate, tested (test_external_backend_refuses_spine_only_with_no_handoff), and blocked by a harness constraint (the Agent tool takes no env-injection parameter), not a run_crew.py defect

discrepancies.signal: ExternalBackend (Commander-to-crew Agent-tool dispatch) cannot go spine-only; a handoff document remains mandatory on that path
discrepancies.affects: #535's broader ask (any dispatch should start with an identifier) is only partially delivered -- true for the CLI-backend/Admiral-to-Commander path, not for the Agent-tool/Commander-to-crew path
discrepancies.reason: Real gap, but the blocker is a harness constraint (no env-injection parameter on the Agent tool primitive) that no change inside scripts/run_crew.py can close -- architecture-level, floated to the Admiral in lane-f-RETURN.md rather than built this run. No issue filed per decision:no-issue-filing-mid-run; staged as a triage candidate instead.

discrepancies.signal: Commander-level mission content (this launch order's own Mission/Pre-Rulings/Latitude/File-Ownership) has no spine-carried representation; spine_open's spec compilation covers only implementer/reviewer gate plans (specs/implementer.spine.toml, specs/reviewer.spine.toml)
discrepancies.affects: A fuller reading of #535 (the launch order's own content riding the spine, not just session identity/binding)
discrepancies.reason: Closing this needs a Commander-level spec schema and spine template in skills/** paths fenced to lane D1 this wave -- out of this lane's file ownership and latitude. Staged as a triage candidate, not built.

repo_state.map_status: No docs/architecture map exists for this repo (skill-source repo); oriented via README.md and skills/commander/references/crew-dispatch.md substitutes (.agent-work/567-f/map-orientation.json)
